description_full: Integra Resources Corp., a precious metals producer, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in the Great Basin of the Western United States. It explores for gold and silver deposits. The company's flagship projects include DeLamar Project which includes 790 unpatented lode, placer, and millsite claims, and 16 tax parcels comprised of patented mining claims covering an area of 8,673 hectares located in southwestern Idaho; and the Nevada North Project located in western Nevada. The company was formerly known as Mag Copper Limited and changed its name to Integra Resources Corp. in August 2017. Integra Resources Corp. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: Integra Resources Corp. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $454M market cap on $244M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +704% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder. Operating margins are expanding by +79.3pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.
Returns on capital run at -151% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 28%.
The business throws off $25M in free cash flow — roughly 10 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
Accruals are elevated at -23.9% of assets, and Sloan showed firms building earnings through accruals rather than cash systematically underperform.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin -5.7× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 0.0% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 7.8% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 2.1× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
